text: static-musl re-scope (직전 feasibility 정정): 블로커는 self/runtime_core_emit.hexa(에미터)가 아니라 **에미터 없는 frozen amalgam seed self/runtime.c**(blob 151c52c82, tool/restore_frozen_seeds:15 "no SSOT emitter")에 있음. 오염영역=runtime.c fortify 매크로블록(line~2076-2126, runtime_core.c include 2168 위) + native .c include블록(net/thread/namespace.c, line~13423-13632, include 아래). 에미터는 이 텍스트를 0개 생성=수정 불가. ⇒ musl-portable fix(시스템 include 재배치/push_macro 가드)는 frozen seed runtime.c 직접편집 + FROZEN_SEED_REF(restore_frozen_seeds:40) 재핀 필요 = 부트스트랩 blob 갱신(거버넌스 sign-off + glibc byteeq-inert 게이트 필수) **또는** runtime.c를 emitter-생성으로 승격(마지막 frozen seed graduate, 대형 프로젝트). 둘 다 사용자 결정 필요. v0.241.0(x86_64 anima unblock)·arm64 runner fix(#3591→v0.241.1 3/3)는 무관하게 출하됨. akida 금지·빌드=aiden/summer.

linux-arm64 stage-0 self-host 트랜스파일 SEGFAULT 회귀 (v0.240→v0.241 사이 코드 회귀) — `./build/hexa_v2 self/module_loader.hexa` exit139(SIGSEGV), **22.04-arm·24.04-arm 양쪽 동일**(tool/stage_build_hexa:54). 즉 #3591(러너 22→24 되돌림)은 헛다리=원인은 러너/glibc 아닌 aarch64 코드젠/런타임. v0.240.0 arm64 asset 정상출하 → v0.241.0/v0.241.1 둘 다 arm64 미발행(2/3). 33커밋(v0.240..v0.241.1) 중 hexa_v2 aarch64 트랜스파일 깨뜨린 커밋 bisect 필요 — 단 linux-arm64 빌드환경 필요(aiden/summer=x86_64·mini=darwin-arm64·**akida 금지**). 후보: GitHub CI 커밋별 release 재실행(느림) 또는 arm64 pod 렌트. 영향: anima 등 x86_64 소비자 무관(v0.241.1 정상), arm64-linux 소비자만(현 활성 소비자 불명). 별개 갭: release.yml이 2/3여도 latest 마킹·발행함 → 채널규율(stable=3타깃green)이 파이프라인 미강제 = gate 추가 필요(all-3-green시만 latest/publish). 빌드=aiden/summer·akida금지.

QFORGE g5 gate BLOCKER (compiler/runtime, C-codegen). A [float] array built from a LIST LITERAL is codegen'd as a packed-f64 array (hexa_arr_f64_new). When that array crosses a fn-VALUE call boundary (hexa_call1, e.g. H_apply matrix-free closure) and is read via hexa_index_get inside the callee, the element returns with a wrong/unboxed tag, so the next hexa_mul aborts: 'cannot multiply non-numeric operand (tag N * tag M)'. 18-line repro isolated: a callee fn receives fn-value f and calls f(x) where x is a float-LITERAL array and f reads a file-global D then does D[i]*v[i]; FAILS. Identical code with push-built (boxed) x: PASSES. Root: packed-f64 element un-tagging across the indirect-call/arena boundary. Impact: ALL matrix-free QFORGE selftests (sternheimer/davidson/dfpt_response) COMPILE clean (hexa build OK, type-check passes, clang links) but DIE at runtime on this -> the from-scratch el-ph |g|2 gate (<1%) cannot be g5-verified on darwin-arm64 until fixed. Fix candidates: (a) box packed-f64 elements when an array is passed to hexa_call1, or (b) hexa_index_get on a packed-f64 array returns a properly TAG_FLOAT-tagged HexaVal. Secondary codegen gap: a 2nd `pub fn` in a module sometimes lacks a forward C prototype -> implicit-int return -> 'initializing HexaVal with int' (seen calling qforge_sternheimer_shift directly). Workaround used to obtain numeric g5 evidence: rewrite the harness with ONLY push-built arrays -> solver runs. Repro env: mini darwin-arm64, hexa build (hexat), HEAD branch feat/cloud-fire-shards. NOTE: `hexa run` interpreter ALSO fails these selftests (different bug: same 'cannot multiply' surfaced via the shipped dispatch interp).
